title: Parameter-Space Heat Flow, Gaussian Density Ratios, and Sharp Hermite Truncation Rates
summary: We reinterpret the classical Hermite generating function as a Gaussian density ratio: relative to the unit Gaussian reference, it is the density ratio of a Gaussian with shifted mean and unchanged covariance. Applying the heat semigroup in the mean-parameter variable to this generating function produces the corresponding temperature variation. Thus the heat-semigroup time variable is reinterpreted as the temperature variation of the Gaussian density ratio.
